description: The platform-wide announcement banner the Rest app shows on every page: maintenance windows, upgrades, and anything else every user must see. One record per notice; several may be scheduled, and the app is served the single most recent one whose window is open.

fields.description: Short heading. Shown before the message and truncated to one line by the app.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: The notice itself. Plain text or simple HTML; the app sanitises it before rendering.
fields.label: Message

fields.description: How alarming this is. info: a neutral notice. warning: something may be affected. critical: an outage or a risk to data.
fields.label: Severity

fields.description: The master switch. An inactive banner is never served, whatever its window says -- so a notice can be written, scheduled and reviewed without appearing.
fields.label: Is Active

fields.description: Whether the app offers a dismiss control. A dismissed banner reappears when its content changes, so an urgent notice cannot be permanently hidden.
fields.label: Dismissible

fields.description: When the banner becomes visible. Leave empty to show it as soon as it is active.
fields.label: Starts At

fields.description: When it stops being visible. Leave empty to show it until it is switched off or replaced. Must be after the start.
fields.label: Ends At

name: Rest Platform Banner
